title: Concept: Ruby exception with its source frames
description: A Ruby exception with a source file and line frame in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The frames name the gem and the application file, so the attacker learns the framework version and the model that failed before designing the next request.
applicability: Deployments that render a Ruby exception with a source file and line frame into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The frames name the gem and the application file, so the attacker learns the framework version and the model that failed before designing the next request.
